package student

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type DiagnosticCatalogReader interface {
	GetDiagnosticAssessmentCatalog(context.Context, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog, error)
}
type DiagnosticTaskReader interface {
	GetDiagnosticTask(context.Context, string) (*answer.TaskMetadata, error)
}

type DiagnosticClock interface{ Now() time.Time }

// DiagnosticAssessments is intentionally disconnected from the ordinary answer
// lifecycle. Its dependencies are limited to its own repository and Course.
type DiagnosticAssessments struct {
	Attempts repository.DiagnosticAssessmentRepository
	Catalog  DiagnosticCatalogReader
	Tasks    DiagnosticTaskReader
	Clock    DiagnosticClock
}

type ReserveDiagnosticAssessmentInput struct {
	Plan                   domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan
	RequestID, RequestHash string
}

func (uc DiagnosticAssessments) Reserve(ctx context.Context, input ReserveDiagnosticAssessmentInput) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, bool, error) {
	if uc.Attempts == nil || uc.Catalog == nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{}, false, errors.New("diagnostic assessments are not configured")
	}
	plan, err := domain.NormalizeDiagnosticAssessmentPlan(input.Plan)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{}, false, err
	}
	if plan.ID != input.RequestID {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if replay, found, replayErr := uc.Attempts.ReplayDiagnosticReservation(ctx, plan.StudentID, plan.ID, input.RequestID, input.RequestHash); replayErr != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{}, false, replayErr
	} else if found {
		return replay, true, nil
	}
	catalog, err := uc.Catalog.GetDiagnosticAssessmentCatalog(ctx, plan.CourseID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{}, false, err
	}
	if !diagnosticPlanMatchesCatalog(plan, catalog) {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return uc.Attempts.ReserveDiagnosticAssessment(ctx, repository.DiagnosticAssessmentReserveCommand{Plan: plan, RequestID: input.RequestID, RequestHash: input.RequestHash, OccurredAt: diagnosticNow(uc.Clock)})
}
func (uc DiagnosticAssessments) Get(ctx context.Context, studentID, attemptID string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, error) {
	if uc.Attempts == nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{}, errors.New("diagnostic assessments are not configured")
	}
	return uc.Attempts.GetDiagnosticAssessment(ctx, studentID, attemptID)
}
func (uc DiagnosticAssessments) GetCurrent(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, error) {
	if uc.Attempts == nil || !canonicalDiagnosticUsecaseID(studentID) {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return uc.Attempts.GetCurrentDiagnosticAssessment(ctx, studentID)
}

// GetTask makes the trusted Course task capability reachable only after an
// owned frozen attempt has been loaded and exact metadata parity is proved.
func (uc DiagnosticAssessments) GetTask(ctx context.Context, studentID, attemptID, taskID string) (*answer.TaskMetadata, error) {
	if uc.Attempts == nil || uc.Tasks == nil || !canonicalDiagnosticUsecaseID(studentID) || !canonicalDiagnosticUsecaseID(attemptID) || !canonicalDiagnosticUsecaseID(taskID) {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	attempt, err := uc.Attempts.GetDiagnosticAssessment(ctx, studentID, attemptID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	frozen := diagnosticFrozenItem(attempt, taskID)
	if frozen == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	task, err := uc.Tasks.GetDiagnosticTask(ctx, frozen.TaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !diagnosticTaskMatches(*frozen, task) || task.EvaluationMode != "AUTO" {
		return nil, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return task, nil
}

type SubmitDiagnosticAssessmentInput struct {
	StudentID, AttemptID, TaskID, RequestID, RequestHash string
	Response                                             json.RawMessage
}

func (uc DiagnosticAssessments) Submit(ctx context.Context, input SubmitDiagnosticAssessmentInput) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, bool, error) {
	if uc.Attempts == nil || uc.Tasks == nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{}, false, errors.New("diagnostic assessments are not configured")
	}
	if !canonicalDiagnosticUsecaseID(input.StudentID) || !canonicalDiagnosticUsecaseID(input.AttemptID) || !canonicalDiagnosticUsecaseID(input.TaskID) {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if replay, found, replayErr := uc.Attempts.ReplayDiagnosticSubmission(ctx, input.StudentID, input.AttemptID, input.TaskID, input.RequestID, input.RequestHash); replayErr != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{}, false, replayErr
	} else if found {
		return replay, true, nil
	}
	attempt, err := uc.Attempts.GetDiagnosticAssessment(ctx, input.StudentID, input.AttemptID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{}, false, err
	}
	frozen := diagnosticFrozenItem(attempt, input.TaskID)
	if frozen == nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{}, false, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	task, err := uc.Tasks.GetDiagnosticTask(ctx, frozen.TaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{}, false, err
	}
	if !diagnosticTaskMatches(*frozen, task) || task.EvaluationMode != "AUTO" {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	correct, err := answer.EvaluateDiagnosticStructuredAssessment(task, input.Response)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{}, false, err
	}
	return uc.Attempts.SubmitDiagnosticAssessment(ctx, repository.DiagnosticAssessmentSubmitCommand{StudentID: input.StudentID, AttemptID: input.AttemptID, TaskID: frozen.TaskID, RequestID: input.RequestID, RequestHash: input.RequestHash, Response: input.Response, Correct: correct, OccurredAt: diagnosticNow(uc.Clock)})
}
func diagnosticFrozenItem(attempt domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, taskID string) *domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanItem {
	for index := range attempt.Items {
		if attempt.Items[index].TaskID == taskID {
			return &attempt.Items[index]
		}
	}
	return nil
}

type CompleteDiagnosticAssessmentInput struct{ StudentID, AttemptID, RequestID, RequestHash string }

func (uc DiagnosticAssessments) Complete(ctx context.Context, input CompleteDiagnosticAssessmentInput) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult, bool, error) {
	if uc.Attempts == nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult{}, false, errors.New("diagnostic assessments are not configured")
	}
	return uc.Attempts.CompleteDiagnosticAssessment(ctx, repository.DiagnosticAssessmentCompleteCommand{StudentID: input.StudentID, AttemptID: input.AttemptID, RequestID: input.RequestID, RequestHash: input.RequestHash, OccurredAt: diagnosticNow(uc.Clock)})
}
func diagnosticNow(clock DiagnosticClock) time.Time {
	if clock == nil {
		return time.Now().UTC()
	}
	return clock.Now().UTC()
}
func canonicalDiagnosticUsecaseID(value string) bool {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && parsed.String() == value
}
func diagnosticPlanMatchesCatalog(plan domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan, catalog domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog) bool {
	if catalog.Schema != "course-diagnostic-assessment-catalog.v1" || catalog.CourseID != plan.CourseID || catalog.CurriculumRevision != plan.CourseContentRevision {
		return false
	}
	byTask := make(map[string]domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalogItem, len(catalog.Items))
	for _, item := range catalog.Items {
		byTask[item.TaskID] = item
	}
	for _, item := range plan.Assessments {
		current, ok := byTask[item.TaskID]
		if !ok || current.LessonID != item.LessonID || current.TaskVersion != item.TaskVersion || !current.UpdatedAt.UTC().Equal(item.UpdatedAt.UTC()) || current.LessonOrder != item.LessonOrder || current.TaskOrder != item.TaskOrder || current.AssessmentPurpose != "diagnostic" || !diagnosticTargetsEqual(current.LearningTargets, item.LearningTargets) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
func diagnosticTaskMatches(frozen domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanItem, task *answer.TaskMetadata) bool {
	if task == nil || task.ID != frozen.TaskID || task.LessonID != frozen.LessonID || task.Version != frozen.TaskVersion || !task.UpdatedAt.UTC().Equal(frozen.UpdatedAt.UTC()) || task.AssessmentPurpose != "diagnostic" || !diagnosticTaskType(task.Type) {
		return false
	}
	return diagnosticTargetsEqual(task.LearningTargets, frozen.LearningTargets)
}
func diagnosticTaskType(value int16) bool {
	switch value {
	case 11, 12, 13:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}
func diagnosticTargetsEqual(left, right []domain.LearningTargetRef) bool {
	left, err := domain.NormalizeDiagnosticLearningTargets(left)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	right, err = domain.NormalizeDiagnosticLearningTargets(right)
	if err != nil || len(left) != len(right) {
		return false
	}
	encodedLeft, _ := json.Marshal(left)
	encodedRight, _ := json.Marshal(right)
	return string(encodedLeft) == string(encodedRight)
}
